<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <!-- Main User Profile Screen Layout Modular composition of: - user_profile_hero.xml: Profile header with avatar, name, email, stats - user_profile_become_host.xml: Promotional card - user_profile_menu_section.xml: Settings menu items - dashboard_bottom_nav.xml: Bottom navigation --> <androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:background="#F5F5F5">
<!-- Main Content ScrollView --> <ScrollView android:id="@+id/profile_scroll_view" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="0dp" app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@id/bottom_nav" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent">
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical">
<!-- Hero Section: Avatar, Name, Email, Stats --> <include layout="@layout/user_profile_hero" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" />
<!-- Become a Host Card --> <include layout="@layout/user_profile_become_host" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" />
<!-- Menu Items Section --> <include layout="@layout/user_profile_menu_section" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" />
<!-- Bottom spacing --> <View android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="20dp" /> </LinearLayout> </ScrollView>
<!-- Bottom Navigation --> <include android:id="@+id/bottom_nav" layout="@layout/dashboard_bottom_nav" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" />
</androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <!-- Become a Host promotional card Reuses: shape_button_blue for button Features: Orange background, call-to-action button, descriptive text --> <LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical" android:background="@drawable/shape_card_orange" android:paddingHorizontal="16dp" android:paddingVertical="20dp" android:layout_marginHorizontal="16dp" android:layout_marginVertical="16dp" android:gravity="center_vertical">
<!-- Create a shape drawable for rounded corners --> <!-- Using android:background with custom drawable approach -->
<!-- Title --> <TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="@string/become_a_host" android:fontFamily="@font/lexend" android:textColor="@android:color/white" android:textSize="18sp" android:textStyle="bold" android:layout_marginBottom="8dp" />
<!-- Description --> <TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="@string/become_a_host_description" android:fontFamily="@font/lexend" android:textColor="@android:color/white" android:textSize="13sp" android:layout_marginBottom="16dp" android:alpha="0.9" />
<!-- Get Started Button --> <Button android:id="@+id/become_host_button" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="40dp" android:text="@string/get_started" android:textAllCaps="false" android:fontFamily="@font/lexend" android:textColor="#FF9800" android:textSize="13sp" android:textStyle="bold" android:paddingHorizontal="28dp" android:background="@drawable/shape_button_white_rounded" />
</LinearLayout>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <!-- User Profile Hero Section Displays: Avatar, Name, Email, and Stats (Bookings, Reviews, Rating) Reuses: bg_white_circle for avatar background --> <LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:background="@drawable/user_login_background" android:orientation="vertical" android:paddingHorizontal="16dp" android:paddingTop="24dp" android:paddingBottom="24dp">
<!-- Profile Header: Avatar, Name, Email --> <LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="horizontal" android:gravity="center_vertical" android:layout_marginBottom="24dp" android:baselineAligned="false">
<!-- Avatar Circle --> <FrameLayout android:layout_width="64dp" android:layout_height="64dp" android:background="@drawable/bg_white_circle" android:layout_marginEnd="16dp">
<ImageView android:id="@+id/profile_avatar" android:layout_width="64dp" android:layout_height="64dp" android:src="@drawable/user_icon" android:scaleType="centerInside" android:padding="12dp" android:contentDescription="@string/profile_avatar" /> </FrameLayout>
<!-- Name and Email Section --> <LinearLayout android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="1" android:orientation="vertical" android:gravity="start">
<TextView android:id="@+id/profile_name" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="@string/user_name_placeholder" android:fontFamily="@font/lexend" android:textColor="@android:color/white" android:textSize="20sp" android:textStyle="bold" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/profile_email" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="@string/user_email_placeholder" android:fontFamily="@font/lexend" android:textColor="@android:color/white" android:textSize="12sp" android:layout_marginTop="4dp" android:alpha="0.8" /> </LinearLayout> </LinearLayout>
<!-- Stats Row: Bookings, Reviews, Rating --> <LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="horizontal" android:gravity="center" android:baselineAligned="false">
<!-- Bookings Stat --> <include layout="@layout/user_profile_stat_item" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="1" android:layout_marginEnd="8dp" />
<!-- Reviews Stat --> <include layout="@layout/user_profile_stat_item" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="1" android:layout_marginHorizontal="8dp" />
<!-- Rating Stat --> <include layout="@layout/user_profile_stat_item" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="1" android:layout_marginStart="8dp" /> </LinearLayout>
</LinearLayout>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <!-- Modular saved property card item layout. Reuses existing drawables: bg_rounded_green_badge, bg_white_circle, shape_tab_selected Design inspired by dashboard_item_product_card.xml with optimizations for grid display. --> <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto" xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_margin="8dp" app:cardCornerRadius="16dp" app:cardElevation="2dp" app:cardBackgroundColor="@android:color/white">
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical">
<!-- Image and Overlays Section --> <FrameLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="220dp">
<!-- Property Image --> <ImageView android:id="@+id/saved_property_image" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:contentDescription="@string/property_image_description" android:scaleType="centerCrop" tools:src="@drawable/property_placeholder" android:background="@android:color/darker_gray"/>
<!-- Verified Badge (Top Left) --> <LinearLayout android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginStart="12dp" android:layout_marginTop="12dp" android:background="@drawable/bg_rounded_green_badge" android:paddingHorizontal="12dp" android:paddingVertical="6dp" android:gravity="center_vertical" android:orientation="horizontal">
<ImageView android:layout_width="14dp" android:layout_height="14dp" android:src="@drawable/check" android:contentDescription="@string/verified_icon" android:scaleType="fitCenter"/>
<TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="@string/verified" android:layout_marginStart="4dp" android:textColor="@android:color/white" android:textSize="12sp" android:fontFamily="@font/lexend" android:textStyle="bold"/> </LinearLayout>
<!-- Favorite Button (Top Right) --> <ImageButton android:id="@+id/saved_favorite_button" android:layout_width="40dp" android:layout_height="40dp" android:layout_gravity="top|end" android:layout_marginTop="12dp" android:layout_marginEnd="12dp" android:background="@drawable/bg_white_circle" android:src="@drawable/saved_icon" android:scaleType="center" android:padding="8dp" android:contentDescription="@string/favorite_button" app:tint="#E74C3C"/>
</FrameLayout>
<!-- Text Content Section --> <LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical" android:paddingHorizontal="16dp" android:paddingVertical="12dp">
<!-- Property Title --> <TextView android:id="@+id/saved_property_title" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" tools:text="Loakan Heights Residences" android:textColor="#212121" android:textSize="16sp" android:textStyle="bold" android:fontFamily="@font/lexend" android:maxLines="2" android:ellipsize="end"/>
<!-- Location with Icon --> <LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="6dp" android:orientation="horizontal" android:gravity="center_vertical">
<ImageView android:layout_width="14dp" android:layout_height="14dp" android:src="@drawable/location_icon" android:contentDescription="@string/location_icon" android:scaleType="fitCenter" app:tint="#757575"/>
<TextView android:id="@+id/saved_property_location" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="1" android:layout_marginStart="4dp" tools:text="Near Camp John Hay" android:textColor="#757575" android:textSize="12sp" android:fontFamily="@font/lexend" android:maxLines="1" android:ellipsize="end"/> </LinearLayout>
<!-- Price Block --> <LinearLayout android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="10dp" android:orientation="horizontal" android:gravity="center_vertical">
<TextView android:id="@+id/saved_property_price" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" tools:text="P6,300" android:textColor="#1976D2" android:textSize="20sp" android:textStyle="bold" android:fontFamily="@font/lexend"/>
<TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginStart="4dp" android:text="@string/price_per_month" android:textColor="#757575" android:textSize="12sp" android:fontFamily="@font/lexend"/> </LinearLayout>
</LinearLayout> </LinearLayout> </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>
